authorized_by: user message: 补齐 KAN20、GRU20、DSSM20 时，应先用同一个小子集、两个种子、统一 Head 和六场 canary 筛选，有竞争力再全量训练。

screen.optimizer_and_loss: The same frozen fast-screen optimizer, batch size, normalization, weighting, target clipping, and loss.
screen.canary: All six existing BRIDGE6 scenes for each candidate and each seed, with matching same-scene B references; 36 additional Plant starts maximum.
screen.selection_metric: Equal-weight mean Q_0_20_m over six scenes, averaged over both trained seeds. Report each seed separately and report same-scene B; do not tune on these six scenes.
screen.advance_to_full_training_only_if: Both seeds complete all six scenes finite and STABLE, and the two-seed mean macro Q is no worse than the current same-group screen winner (KAN20 vs MLP14; GRU20/DSSM20 vs GRU14).

scope_constraints: Do not edit the original frozen protocol or preregistered configuration list.
Do not modify B, the training/validation contract, or existing teacher/student/test data.
Do not collect new teacher data or run TEST.
Treat this as a separately logged user-authorized extension.
